zh: 我想跟大家聊一个，所有人都在听，
en: I want to talk about a term everyone hears.

zh: 但90%的人都理解错误的词：
en: But 90% of people misunderstand it:

zh: 超级个体。
en: the super individual.

zh: 很多人以为啊，
en: Many people assume

zh: 超级个体是AI时代新造出来的一个概念，
en: the super individual is a concept invented in the AI era,

zh: 是人工智能爆发之后才有的新物种。
en: a new species born only after the AI boom.

zh: 但是我的理解是，超级个体从来不是AI诞生的产物，
en: My view is that super individuals were never created by AI.

zh: 它一直都存在。以前呢，
en: They have always existed. In the past,

zh: 我们叫他斜杠青年、全能型人才，
en: we called them multi-hyphenate professionals or versatile talent,

zh: 多面手，什么都懂、什么都能接，
en: all-rounders who understand and take on many things,

zh: 什么难题都能落地。
en: and turn difficult problems into results.

zh: 而今天的AI，不是帮你从零变大神，而是把原来具备潜力的普通人，
en: Today AI does not turn a novice into a master from nothing. It takes an ordinary person with potential

zh: 直接放大成超级个体。工具人人平等，
en: and amplifies them into a super individual. Tools are equal for everyone.

zh: 模型人人可用，会员人人能充。
en: Everyone can use the models and pay for the same memberships.

zh: 那么未来拉开人与人距离的，
en: What will separate people in the future

zh: 从来不是你会不会用AI，
en: is not whether you can use AI,

zh: 而是你能不能用AI快速驾驭
en: but whether you can use it to quickly handle

zh: 所有的陌生领域。真正的超级个体，
en: unfamiliar fields. A true super individual

zh: 根本不是死磕一门技术、埋头苦干、
en: does not just grind away at one technical skill

zh: 单打独斗。我给大家讲透
en: or work alone. Let me explain

zh: 超级个体的核心本质。
en: the core of the super individual.

zh: 第一，六边形的综合适配能力。
en: First: broad, hexagonal adaptability.

zh: 你可以不用精通所有领域，
en: You do not need to master every field,

zh: 但你必须什么都能接、什么都能懂。
en: but you must be able to understand and take on many kinds of work.

zh: 会航拍、会拍摄、会剪辑、会做短视频，
en: You can fly a drone, shoot, edit, and make short videos.

zh: 能自导自演、能做内容落地。
en: You can direct, perform, and turn content into working results.

zh: 不需要每一项都是顶级的专业，
en: You do not have to be elite at every skill,

zh: 但每一项你都能快速地上手，独立地出结果。
en: but you can learn each one quickly and independently produce results.

zh: 第二，就是陌生领域的极速破局能力。
en: Second: breaking into unfamiliar fields at speed.

zh: 很多老板、很多创业者最怕的是什么？
en: What do many business owners and entrepreneurs fear most?

zh: 接到自己没做过、没接触过、完全陌生的项目。
en: A project they have never done, touched, or understood before.

zh: 普通人的表现是：没做过、不会、放弃、推脱。
en: The usual response is: never done it, cannot do it, give up, pass it on.

zh: 而超级个体：我没有做过，
en: A super individual says: I have not done it before,

zh: 但是我能快速地懂、快速地学、快速地落地。
en: but I can understand, learn, and deliver quickly.

zh: 别人跟你聊行业内幕、专业逻辑、项目难点，
en: When others discuss insider knowledge, professional logic, and project difficulty,

zh: 你不用提前深耕几年。
en: you do not need years of prior immersion.

zh: 借助AI，你可以瞬间搭建完成行业的框架、
en: With AI, you can quickly build the industry framework,

zh: 业务逻辑和执行流程。
en: business logic, and execution process.

zh: 就像导航一样，
en: It is like navigation.

zh: 别人给你一个陌生的目的地，
en: Someone gives you an unfamiliar destination,

zh: 你立刻有线路、有方向、有执行步骤。
en: and you immediately have a route, direction, and action steps.

zh: 这就是超级个体的核心：借助工具，
en: That is the core of a super individual: use tools

zh: 快速补齐认知，快速落地结果。
en: to close knowledge gaps and deliver results quickly.

zh: 第三，最高级的能力：资源与人才的调度组织能力。
en: Third, the highest-level skill: organizing resources and talent.

zh: 真正的超级个体，绝对不是单打独斗。
en: A true super individual never works entirely alone.

zh: 未来的项目，绝对不靠自己死磕硬干。
en: Future projects will not be won by grinding alone.

zh: 你要学会一件事情：
en: You need to learn one thing:

zh: 调度资源、匹配人才、组织协作。
en: deploy resources, match talent, and organize collaboration.

zh: 这个和我们调用AI Agent、调用不同大模型，
en: This is the same logic as calling AI agents and different models.

zh: 是一模一样的逻辑。
en: The underlying logic is identical.

zh: 不同的模型擅长不同的领域。
en: Different models are good at different things.

zh: 有的人擅长拍摄，
en: Some people excel at shooting,

zh: 有的人擅长剪辑，
en: some at editing,

zh: 有的人擅长策划，
en: some at planning,

zh: 有的人擅长商务。
en: and some at business development.

zh: 超级个体的核心本事是：一个新项目
en: The key skill of a super individual is this: when a new project

zh: 进来之后，我不用自己全干。
en: arrives, I do not do everything myself.

zh: 我清楚知道谁最适合干什么，
en: I know who is best suited for each task,

zh: 什么环节找谁，
en: and who to call at each stage,

zh: 如何把所有人串联成一套完整闭环。
en: and how to connect everyone into a complete delivery loop.

zh: 你能整合人、整合工具、整合资源，
en: If you can integrate people, tools, and resources,

zh: 你就是这个时代最稀缺的超级个体。
en: you become one of the rarest super individuals of this era.

zh: 最后呢，我总结一句扎心的话：
en: Finally, here is the hard truth:

zh: AI抹平了所有工具的差距。
en: AI has made access to tools broadly equal.

zh: 别人能用的模型，你也能用；
en: You can use the same models as everyone else.

zh: 别人能开的会员，你也能开；
en: You can buy the same memberships.

zh: 别人能学的教程，你也能学。
en: You can learn from the same tutorials.

zh: 未来的核心差异化只有一条：
en: The future has only one core differentiator:

zh: 谁能更快地用AI吃透陌生领域，
en: who can use AI to understand unfamiliar fields faster,

zh: 谁能更快地落地全新项目，
en: who can deliver new projects faster,

zh: 谁能更好地组织资源、整合团队，
en: and who can better organize resources and teams.

zh: 谁就是AI时代真正的超级个体。
en: That person is the true super individual of the AI era.

zh: 时代从不淘汰努力的人，
en: The times do not leave hardworking people behind.

zh: 只淘汰固守单一能力、
en: They leave behind those locked into a single ability,

zh: 不会借力、不会迭代的人。
en: unable to leverage others or keep evolving.

zh: 看懂趋势，借势AI，
en: Understand the trend and leverage AI.

zh: 人人都可以成为超级个体。
en: Everyone can become a super individual.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao Ge, building an AI business in Lanzhou.
